pages.text: Base cost: 40. Cooldown: 8s. Absorbs 12 HP for up to 12 seconds.
Hold R to select. Tap G for slot 1 or hold G for about 0.4 seconds for slot 2. Alternate forms add 4 concentration; each cost upgrade saves 2. Signs are disabled in official bouts.
Shield burst: Damage nearby enemies when the shield breaks.
Reflection: Return part of absorbed damage to the attacker.
Protection aura: Share your shield with nearby teammates.
